description.value:
You learn about fallen civilizations by digging through what they left behind — ruins, tombs, forgotten holocrons, the bones of empires nobody remembers the names of anymore. Crumbled temples and buried dungeons across the galaxy have taught you more history than any archive.

You know how to read a half-collapsed structure for who built it and why, and you've never once been able to walk past an unexplored ruin without wondering what's still buried inside.

system.equipment: A map (physical or digital) to a ruin or dig site, a lantern, a vibropick, a set of traveler's clothes, a shovel, a two-person tent, and a pouch containing 250 credits.
